name: GRG Banking Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: GRG Banking Equipment Co., Ltd. provides artificial intelligence solutions for financial self-service industry in China and internationally. the company operates through two segments: FinTech and Smart City. It provides intelligent self-service equipment; and AI-driven visual big data, smart building technologies, and advanced transportation systems. It offers automatic teller machines, and recyclers; and digital branch; content management; cash sorting machines, terminal operation, and security; multifunctional smart branch; community smart branch; and branch on wheels, a mobile bank.
